Har project mein ply badalne ka jhanjhat chhoriye aur VAJRA PP shuttering sheet apnaiye.

Sahi handling ke saath yeh sheet ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai aur har dhalai ka kharcha kam karti hai. Pan-India dispatch Raipur se available hai.
